title: parse xml from a column in table-pyspark
question:
I have a column in table with values in below format

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Items><Item><articleId>9999</articleId><inHandDifference>99</inHandDifference><articleName>SOMENAME</articleName><articleCode>1234</articleCode><cappingLimit>12</cappingLimit><unitOfMeasure>EA</unitOfMeasure><quantityInHand>10</quantityInHand><someid>IA56</someid><someotherid>1234</someotherid></Item></Items>

When using with pyspark, and using dfdata.show, value is showing as 999999SOMENAME123412EA10IA561234

Please can someone suggest how to handle this as I need to read xml data and parse to individual columns, please?

We are on spark 2.x
answer:
You can import xml files with:

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import *
from pyspark.sql.types import *

spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("ReadXML").getOrCreate()

xmlFile = "path/to/xml/file.xml"

df = spark.read \
    .format('com.databricks.spark.xml') \
    .options(rowTag='.//Item') \
    .load(xmlFile)

df.show()
